positive_snippets: We stayed with family at this property for two days. Our overall experience is very good. All staffs were very polite, room, washroom were spacious, clean. Food was excellent. Most important part is this property situated inside Suncity township, which is maintained very good. We enjoyed our stay.
Very good rooms, Excellent location , food & Service

We had booked several rooms for visiting relatives from overseas and other states for a family event. I must say services rendered and assistance offered were superb. Manager Varghese kept in touch constantly and arranged homely dinner for all in no time when one of our plans went in hot waters.
Perfect place and conveniently located near mono rail station, taxis, autos, banks, hospitals nearby. South indian reataurant Navedyam across the road amd Bikanerwala just 5 minutes walk, starbucks etc within 100 meters.
Prices are most reasonable 👌😊
I also spoke to the owner and she was extremely helpful and accommodating!!!
Loved the experience 👍
